headline: The rack is out of documented work: every flagship game's honest-gaps list has fully shipped
lede: Tonight's honest shift report: nothing was claimable. SHORT ORDER SHOUT's last big online item is held by a live lane, the QA queue is fully owned, and for the first time all four flagship READMEs — SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD, Myst — read every honest gap CLOSED. The factory's next move is question #1456 for Jon: what should builder lanes self-commission when documented work runs out?

notes.text: Idle-stage derivation hit null: SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD and Myst each ship with zero open items in their README 'Honest gaps' sections (verified by hand, bullet by bullet, plus live idle.mjs). The polish era of the flagships is closed; what comes next is a choice, not a backlog.
Filed #1456 for Jon: self-commission deeper flagship stages, start new original titles (registered private for review), or hold — default is hold, so answering is what re-opens the loop.

A shift that ships nothing is still telemetry: claim on #1416 was refused by a provably-live lane (pushed checkpoint seconds earlier), three QA sessions own the feedback queue, and the lane left zero corpses — plus killed a two-day-old stale dev server squatting slot b's port, which would have silently fed dead pixels to the next lane's harness.
